description_en: Retrieves the list of members in a specified department
description_zh: 组织管理/获取部门成员列表
name: ModelRouterListDeptMembers

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include the monthly and permanent balance of the member's sub-wallet
parameters.help_zh: 是否追加成员子钱包月度/永久余额
parameters.name: include_balance

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include the authorized models and the number of associated keys for the member
parameters.help_zh: 是否追加成员已授权模型与归属Key数
parameters.name: include_authorization

parameters.help_en:
The authorization configuration filter. Valid values:
inherit: only members that inherit department settings.
custom: only members with custom settings.
Empty: all members
parameters.help_zh: 授权配置筛选：inherit=仅继承部门/custom=仅已定制/空=全部
parameters.name: auth_config

parameters.help_en: Filters members by the authorized model ID
parameters.name: model
